 ADVERTISEMENT   Filtered By: Topstories News PCSO Lotto Results: No winner of P305M Grand Lotto prize in Oct.26 draw 
 By GMA News Published October 26, 2026 10:25pm 
 + Add GMA on Google Make this your preferred source to get more updates from this publisher on Google. FILE PHOTO No bettors took home the Grand Lotto 6/55 prize of over P305 million after no winners were announced in any of the major lotto jackpot draws on October 26, 2026, the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) said Monday.
 The Grand Lotto jackpot of P305,120,397.13 was left unclaimed after no bettor played the winning numbers of 27-38-44-51-20-47.
 The odds of winning the jackpot for Grand Lotto 6/55 are 1 in 28,989,675 .
 Winners remained elusive for Megalotto 6/45 as no bettor selected the numbers of 06-34-45-36-30-16 that would have yielded the P15 million prize.
